The '''Armored Krakkiss''' was a giant, beige-[[Color/Legends|colored]] armadillo-like creature native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It had thick plating covering its body, and its only vulnerable part was its head. It attacked its prey by rolling like a ball towards the enemy or by swinging its tail against the opponent, or trying to use the environment against it.<ref name="Power Battles" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] dueled an Armored Krakkiss.<ref name="Power Battles" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Armored Krakkiss appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'']].
